about.text: The State of Louisiana sought dissolution of a consent decree it entered more than thirty years ago based on its satisfaction of each remedial action contained therein. When faced with the State’s motion to dissolve, however, the district court declined to relinquish control over and dissolve the decree, finding that the State failed to meet its burden under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 60(b)(5).
